{{Quote|There hasn't been a ship, station, or soft target that we haven't blown to hell, sir. That's how we got our name.|[[Sharp]], in a conversation with Jedi Master Kit Fisto|<ref name="Seven">[[The Clone Wars 7|''The Clone Wars'' 7]]</ref>}}
'''Devil Dogs''' was a unit of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] within the [[44th Special Operations Division]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], they served under the command of [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Kendal Ozzel/Legends|Kendal Ozzel]] where they found themselves sent on highly dangerous combat missions.

==History==
{{Expandsect}}
During the [[Battle of Khorm/Legends|Battle of Khorm]], the Devil Dogs were assigned to aid [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] and [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] to destroy a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] climate-control station. When they stopped to bury a group of dead [[Khormai/Legends|Khormai]] at [[Adaroo]]'s request, they chose to help with the burial detail, feeling that by finishing the burial quickly, they could get back to the mission at hand.<ref name="ISOTR" />
